About The College
Behali Degree College, affiliated to Gauhati University was established in 1989 by some enthusiastic and active citizens of Behali. In a recent notification dated 10/02/2024, Govt. of Assam Higher Education Department listed Behali Degree College to Madhabdev University. It now stands as a premier institute in the Biswanath district. The college is proud of its alumni who have carved their names in various educational and professional fields.
With the establishment of Science stream in 2020, the college now has number of highly qualified faculty members who are catering to over a thousand students. The college strongly believes the new students will be highly benefitted by its teaching staff.

Dear Learners,
Greetings!
As we gear up for another academic year filled with promise and potential, it gives me great pleasure to extend a warm welcome to all prospective students to Behali Degree College, Borgang.
Behali Degree College stands out as one of the leading undergraduate institutions in Biswanath District, maintaining high academic standards and offering accessible, quality education to empower students from all walks of life. Recently accredited with a B+ Grade from NAAC, our college has been pivotal in providing higher education opportunities, nurturing talents, instilling true human values, and fostering universal brotherhood particularly in rural and remote areas. The increasing enrolment figures underscore the college’s significance and demand in the greater Behali area.
The college has adopted a Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) in line with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020since the last academic year (2023-24). This policy promotes critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and creativity through a flexible credit-based system. It encourages interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary learning, allowing students to explore various fields of study and customize their educational journey based on their interests and aspirations. Moreover, with study centers from Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU) and Gauhati University Centre for Distance and Online Education (GUCDOE) within our campus, education is easily accessible to all learners, regardless of age, and academic background.
Our college offers undergraduate courses in 13 disciplines, leading to B.A. degrees in Assamese, Economics, Education, English, History, Philosophy, Political Science, and Sanskrit, as well as B.Sc. degrees in Botany, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, and Zoology. Our experienced, highly qualified, and dedicated faculty members are here to guide and support you in every step of your journey, ensuring that your time at Behali Degree College is not only academically enriching but also personally fulfilling.
Furthermore, the college is actively involved in community service programmes through its extension cells. Our students participate in NSS and NCC activities, contributing to nation-building endeavours. We prioritize both academic excellence and co-curricular activities, providing facilities for students to develop their talents. The college continually integrates state-of-the-art facilities into its teaching-learning programmes.
I am delighted to invite you to explore the opportunities that await you at Behali Degree College and join us in shaping the future leaders of tomorrow.
